messages.content:
You record concise, auditable applicability findings for an experimental
commercial-driver assessment in English. Do not produce an overall fitness outcome
in this stage. Evaluate EVERY supplied passage exactly once. Return the required
passages object with keys P1, P2 and so on. Each key is already bound to one original
passage by the application's applicability_slot metadata; do not output or change
module names or passage identifiers. Evaluate the text assigned to that slot.
These findings are model proposals, not established clinical facts.

Only verified_patient_facts establish patient findings. Use their exact stored
values: false is an explicit negative, zero is a value, absent or null is unknown.
The nurse note gives context only. Do not promote a historical, family, negated,
uncertain or unverified statement to a current verified patient finding. A diagnosis
already established is different from an undiagnosed symptom under investigation.
Do not infer loss of consciousness from tiredness alone.

For each complete original passage:
- Identify the statement type and the licensing pathway it actually discusses.
  A referral or a possible conditional licence is not an established prohibition
  or permission. Excluding unconditional licensing alone does not exclude both
  pathways and does not by itself establish a current temporary driving hold.
- State whether its patient conditions apply, do not apply, or remain uncertain.
  Read negative values, treatment category, current/historical status and diagnosed
  cause explicitly. An applicable passage may still have unmet prerequisites.
- Record each material prerequisite as met, not_met or unknown, referencing only
  supplied verified fields. Combine closely related requirements if necessary;
  never omit an unknown qualification to turn a possibility into permission.
- For quantitative criteria, describe the comparison using the exact supplied
  patient value, units and inequality in the original passage; do not round a
  boundary, invent a measurement, or import an external threshold. If no comparison
  is relevant write 'Not applicable'. If units or measurements are absent say so.
- Distinguish established_restriction, conditional_permission, not_established and
  information_missing. A conditional_permission requires affirmative support for
  all relevant prerequisites. A treatment name alone is insufficient. A restriction
  needs an applicable restrictive clause and verified supporting patient facts.

Select only supplied verified fact fields. Keep each conclusion concise.
Do not copy the passage or provide private reasoning. The application resolves the
unchanged original text and patient values; it does not verify your interpretation.

spans.original_quote:
1.2.3. Blackouts due to medical 
causes not covered in the standards
If the cause of the blackout is determined 
to be a medical condition not covered in 
the standards, then first principles regarding 
fitness to drive should be applied (refer to 
Part A section 2. Assessing fitness to drive 
– general guidance). Considerations include 
the likelihood of recurrence of blackout and 
the treatability of the condition as well as the 
nature of the driving task. There should also be 
an appropriate review period. A more stringent 
approach should be considered for commercial 
vehicle drivers.

messages.content:
You propose an experimental commercial-driver fitness assessment in English.
Use only supplied verified_patient_facts and original guideline_evidence. The nurse
note gives context, not permission to promote unverified or negated findings.
Missing information is not normal. This is not a clinical licensing decision.
Apply the following output-category meanings to the supplied original evidence:
- meets_unconditional_standard: the applicable unconditional requirements are supported;
  do not infer that unknown patient findings are normal.
- may_meet_conditional_standard: the evidence allows a conditional standard and the
  patient facts establish the relevant prerequisites, not just a treatment name.
- temporarily_unfit: an applicable current restriction requires stopping driving
  pending investigation, recovery or stabilisation. Unknown information in another
  module does not erase an already established current restriction.
- does_not_meet_standard: supplied applicable evidence explicitly excludes both
  unconditional AND conditional current eligibility. Failure of an unconditional
  criterion alone does not prove failure of every conditional pathway. This
  category does not itself mean permanent disqualification.
- insufficient_information: no stronger supported restrictive conclusion can be
  established and required facts or applicable guideline evidence are missing.



This is the aggregation stage. An independent preceding call recorded a proposed
applicability ledger for every supplied original passage. Read the SAME original
facts and passages again. The ledger is fallible: never treat its findings as new
patient facts or as a verified clinical authority. Return your own final criterion
checks, outcome and concise explanation. If a ledger interpretation is wrong,
correct your final check against the ORIGINAL passage and explain the disagreement.
The stored preceding ledger remains unchanged for independent review.

Use the exact scope of each applicable original clause. Distinguish failure of an
unconditional criterion, exclusion of both pathways, and an explicit current
no-driving instruction. A mere referral or missing conditional prerequisite does
not create a temporary prohibition. Unknown findings do not establish normality,
and an unresolved unrelated module does not erase an established restriction.
Do not grant a conditional standard from a possibility or a treatment label when
required qualifications remain unknown. Do not apply an investigation-only rule to
an already diagnosed cause. Do not apply a negated condition to this patient.

Return assessment_outcome, explanation and 1 to 5 criterion_checks using supplied

answer.explanation: The patient has a confirmed blackout event where the mechanism is explicitly 'under_investigation'. Guideline evidence (PASS-d230e17d97c6db53b703c726) explicitly states that people should be advised not to drive until the mechanism is ascertained and the corresponding standard met. The nurse note confirms the investigation is ongoing. While other modules (vision, BP) are normal, the established restriction regarding the unascertained blackout overrides them. The ledger's claim of 'not_applicable' for restrictions is incorrect because the guideline provides a clear procedural instruction to stop driving pending ascertainment, which constitutes a temporary prohibition.

criterion_checks.conclusion: The guideline explicitly advises against driving until the mechanism is ascertained. The patient's status is 'under_investigation', meaning the prerequisite for resuming driving (ascertainment) is not met.
criterion_checks.guideline_quote:
cardiovascular and neurological investigations 
and referral to several specialists. People should 
be advised not to drive until the mechanism is 
ascertained and the corresponding standard met.
Some drivers may attribute a crash or driving 
mishap to a ‘blackout’ to excuse an event 
that occurred for some other reason such as 
inattention or distraction (e.g. a mobile phone 
conversation). There will also be a small 
proportion of cases in which a clear cause 
cannot be established.

criterion_checks.conclusion: The standard for 'undetermined mechanism' applies only after investigation is complete or if the cause remains undetermined despite extensive investigation. The current state ('under_investigation') prevents application of any fitness standard that would permit driving.
criterion_checks.guideline_quote:
1.2.4. Blackouts of undetermined 
mechanism
If, despite extensive investigation, the 
mechanism of a blackout cannot be determined, 
fitness to drive should be assessed according 
to section 1.3. Medical standards for licensing. 
The standards for blackout of undetermined 
mechanism are similar to those for seizure.

criterion_checks.conclusion: Conditional licensing for commercial drivers with undetermined blackouts requires an opinion from a treating specialist that the risk is acceptably low. This assessment lacks the established diagnosis required to form such an opinion.
criterion_checks.guideline_quote:
Commercial standards
(Drivers of heavy vehicles, public passenger 
vehicles or requiring a dangerous goods 
driver licence – refer to definition in Table 3)
Where a person with one or more blackouts 
of undetermined mechanism does not 
meet the standards above for a conditional 
licence but may, in the opinion of the 
treating specialist, be safe to drive, a 
conditional licence may be considered by 
the driver licensing authority, subject to at 
least annual review:
•	 if the driver licensing authority, after 
considering information provided by the 
treating specialist(s), considers that the 
risk of a crash caused by a blackout is 
acceptably low.

criterion_checks.conclusion: The hierarchy of standards requires a firm diagnosis to apply specific medical standards. Without a diagnosis, no standard can be met.

criterion_checks.guideline_quote:
1.2.3. Blackouts due to medical 
causes not covered in the standards
If the cause of the blackout is determined 
to be a medical condition not covered in 
the standards, then first principles regarding 
fitness to drive should be applied (refer to 
Part A section 2. Assessing fitness to drive 
– general guidance). Considerations include 
the likelihood of recurrence of blackout and 
the treatability of the condition as well as the 
nature of the driving task. There should also be 
an appropriate review period. A more stringent 
approach should be considered for commercial 
vehicle drivers.

(Drivers of heavy vehicles, public passenger 
vehicles or requiring a dangerous goods 
driver licence – refer to definition in Table 3)
Where a person with one or more blackouts 
of undetermined mechanism does not 
meet the standards above for a conditional 
licence but may, in the opinion of the 
treating specialist, be safe to drive, a 
conditional licence may be considered by 
the driver licensing authority, subject to at 
least annual review:
•	 if the driver licensing authority, after 
considering information provided by the 
treating specialist(s), considers that the 
risk of a crash caused by a blackout is 
acceptably low.

criterion_checks.conclusion: The hierarchy of standards requires a firm diagnosis to apply specific medical standards. Without a diagnosis, no standard can be met.

criterion_checks.guideline_quote:
1.2.3. Blackouts due to medical 
causes not covered in the standards
If the cause of the blackout is determined 
to be a medical condition not covered in 
the standards, then first principles regarding 
fitness to drive should be applied (refer to 
Part A section 2. Assessing fitness to drive 
– general guidance). Considerations include 
the likelihood of recurrence of blackout and 
the treatability of the condition as well as the 
nature of the driving task. There should also be 
an appropriate review period. A more stringent 
approach should be considered for commercial 
vehicle drivers.

check.conclusion: The guideline explicitly advises against driving until the mechanism is ascertained. The patient's status is 'under_investigation', meaning the prerequisite for resuming driving (ascertainment) is not met.

spans.original_quote:
1.2.4. Blackouts of undetermined 
mechanism
If, despite extensive investigation, the 
mechanism of a blackout cannot be determined, 
fitness to drive should be assessed according 
to section 1.3. Medical standards for licensing. 
The standards for blackout of undetermined 
mechanism are similar to those for seizure.

check.conclusion: The standard for 'undetermined mechanism' applies only after investigation is complete or if the cause remains undetermined despite extensive investigation. The current state ('under_investigation') prevents application of any fitness standard that would permit driving.
